instruction: Enable tap-to-click functionality on Ubuntu's touchpad for easier navigation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling tap-to-click feature on touchpad. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent enabled it (changed to true). Uses GNOME touchpad peripherals schema.
